company.name: 信孚產業股份有限公司

items.text: Cross-Platform Data Centralization: Build and maintain API integrations to pull sales, inventory, and pricing data from Amazon (SP-API), Walmart, Home Depot, and Shopify into a centralized database.
Shopify & Web Development: Enhance our Shopify storefronts (gomichaelpro.com, grandties.com) via liquid coding, app integration, and UI/UX optimization.
ERP Maintenance & Integration: Manage and optimize the connection between our ERP system and online marketplaces to ensure real-time inventory accuracy.
Global Business Intelligence: Collaborate with Taiwan and US teams to build automated reporting dashboards (using PowerBI, Tableau, or custom SQL views).
Innovative Platform Development: Lead the technical architecture for our new "Portable Shop" model - mobile retail units via a dedicated mobile-web platform.
AI Marketing Collaboration: Work with the AI team to automate creative marketing deployments and data-driven ad targeting.

key_values.text:
Critical Skills: * Languages: Proficiency in Python (for automation/data scripts) and SQL (database management).
APIs: Extensive experience with REST APIs, particularly Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) and Shopify API.
Web: Knowledge of HTML/CSS/Javascript and Shopify Liquid.
Experience: 3+ years in E-commerce backend development or systems integration.
Soft Skills: Ability to coordinate between Taiwan HQ and the US/Europe sales teams; professional English proficiency is a plus.
